slides.eyebrow: No one talks about this but...
slides.sub: Moving to Long Hill? Each station handles parking its own way. Swipe before you buy a permit.

slides.title: Gillette
slides.meta: Valley Rd and Long Hill Rd
slides.body: On the Gladstone Branch since 1872. You get a platform shelter, one ticket machine and bike racks.

slides.title: Stirling
slides.body: Two small permit lots, one at Central Ave and Elm St, one at Railroad Ave and Main Ave. There's one ticket machine in the shelter.

slides.title: Millington
slides.body: A 1901 stone station on the National Register of Historic Places. There's a cafe inside now, and the ticket machine is right outside it.

slides.title: 3 stops, one branch line
slides.tip: Parking is free at all 3 from 3 PM Friday to 8 PM Sunday. Check NJ Transit alerts first.
